    • events

      @Deprecated public List<Event> events()
      Deprecated.
      Prefer immutableEvents() when reading or iterating over events (to avoid ConcurrentModificationException), and addEvent(Event) or addEvents(Collection) when appending events.
      Returns the mutable list of events backing this session, which also serves as the monitor for all event-helper synchronization.

    • immutableEvents

      public com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList<Event> immutableEvents()
      Returns a thread-safe, immutable snapshot of the session's events, synchronizing on the backing events() list. Use this method whenever reading, iterating, streaming, filtering, or slicing (List.subList(int, int)) session events to avoid ConcurrentModificationException under concurrent modifications.

    • addEvent

      public void addEvent(Event event)
      Appends a single Event to the session's event list while synchronizing on the backing events() list; prefer over events().add(event).

    • addEvents

      public void addEvents(Collection<Event> events)
      Appends all Events in the given collection to the session's event list while synchronizing on the backing events() list; prefer over events().addAll(events).
